name: Historion: Babylons Fluch
summary: Historion: Babylons Fluch is the sequel to Historion. Computer viruses revived demons from antiquity and they are threatening humanity's history. By travelling back in time you are trying to prevent that by solving riddles and puzzles in places like the pyramids of Gizeh, the temple of Ephesos or the hanging gardens of Babylon. The game also teaches the player about architecture, religion, society and politics of the eras.
